_comment: The real keeper list, one entry per manager per season. Sleeper does not record this league's keepers — its is_keeper flag is set on 2 of about 36 picks in 2026 — so without this file the site works them out from pre-draft rosters and market discounts, which is a guess and says so. Anything written here wins outright. Names must match the draft board's spelling; a name written under the wrong manager marks nobody rather than marking the wrong player.

exceptions.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
exceptions.note: R7 (2025) -> R5 (2026) is unexplained by the rule; flagged, not modeled

_comment_players: players{} is computed by build-trade-grades.mjs (do not hand-edit except rights[]). rights[] is hand-entered: reverting keeper rights are not in any public Sleeper endpoint.
